conclusion.rationale: The patch introduces a new config parameter (systemd.notifyReadyDelay) and changes the default systemd READY=1 timing from always-wait to immediate. While the config parameter change is additive and backward-compatible, the default behavior change (immediate READY=1 vs historical delayed) is a behavioral incompatibility for operators relying on rsyslog delaying READY=1 until module readiness. The new config option global(systemd.notifyReadyDelay='on') restores the historical behavior. Coverage gate not met (35% vs 80% threshold) due to daemon-mode paths not being exercisable in -N1 config validation mode.
